name: The Grove at Shrewsbury
summary: The Grove at Shrewsbury is an upscale lifestyle center in Monmouth County, New Jersey, featuring a premium mix of wellness-focused tenants including Alo and Solidcore, alongside unique retail and dining options. This open-air plaza serves as a community gathering place for health-conscious, affluent residents seeking quality shopping and experiential retail.
demographics: The Grove at Shrewsbury attracts an affluent, health-conscious demographic primarily consisting of upper-middle-class families and professionals from Monmouth County, New Jersey. The trade area includes households with above-average incomes, typically ranging from $100,000 to $200,000+, with a strong presence of dual-income families aged 30-55. Visitors are drawn to premium fitness, wellness, and lifestyle brands, reflecting a preference for quality over value shopping. The center serves as a community gathering place for residents of Shrewsbury, Red Bank, and surrounding upscale Shore communities who prioritize experiential retail and health-focused amenities.
description: The Grove at Shrewsbury is a premier lifestyle destination located in the heart of Monmouth County, New Jersey, offering a carefully curated mix of upscale retail, dining, and wellness experiences. This open-air plaza has established itself as a community hub where residents can shop, dine, and pursue their wellness goals in an inviting outdoor setting. The center features an impressive lineup of fitness and wellness tenants, including the recently opened Alo yoga and activewear sanctuary, which hosted an exclusive VIP early access event, and the upcoming Solidcore studio opening in Spring at Grove West, bringing science-backed slow-burn workouts to the community. Beyond fitness, The Grove houses unique retail concepts like The Studio and The Chameleon, creating a diverse shopping experience that caters to discerning tastes. With flexible seasonal hours and a commitment to creating a welcoming atmosphere, The Grove at Shrewsbury has become more than just a shopping center—it's a lifestyle destination where the community comes together to meet their 2026 goals and beyond.
